programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick travels to Ayrshire to meet the butchers behind a world-famous bacon. Plus, he reveals his recipe for lamb koftas with yoghurt and salad. S2, Ep11

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Lord Coke invites Rick and Chalky to go partridge shooting in Norfolk. Plus, Rick rediscovers traditional favourites like Kentish cobnuts and quinces. S2, Ep12

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: A trip to Strangford Lough, Northern Ireland, inspires Rick to cook delicious dishes with oysters and langoustines. Plus, he spends time with a deer farmer. S2, Ep13

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: On his gastronomic tour of Britain, Rick samples air-dried ham and a steak and seaweed pie. Plus, he cooks freshly caught flounder from South Wales. S2, Ep14

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick prepares pan-fried John Dory with boulangère potatoes and mushrooms. Later, he visits a farmer who has bounced back from the foot-and-mouth crisis. S2, Ep15

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein goes on a pigeon shoot in Cornwall, inspiring him to cook pigeon and peas. Plus, after visiting Devon, he makes a warm skate salad. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein cooks sautéed chicken with 40 cloves of garlic and a warm pheasant salad. Plus, he learns how cider is made at an old-fashioned cider farm in Somerset. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick visits a free-range goose farm in Leicester, inspiring him to tackle a roast goose dish. Plus, he visits the oldest eel and pie shop in London. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick experiences the Lake District's quality produce. He cooks a Chinese-inspired wild boar stew. Plus, he meets a farmer who keeps Herdwick sheep. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein makes the popular steak and kidney pudding as well as poached pears with mascarpone ice cream. Plus, he visits a walled garden in East Sussex. S1, Ep5
